title: Mr. Khalil, 58M — STEMI (extracted from clinical note)

case_journey.event: substernal chest pain — radiating to left arm and jaw
case_journey.label: substernal chest pain — radiating to left arm and jaw

_provenance.source_text: presents to the ED with substernal chest pain radiating to the left arm and jaw
with a history of hypertension
type 2 diabetes mellitus (on metformin)
30 pack-year smoking history
He denies syncope or palpitations
father with MI at 62
BP 88/54, HR 112, RR 22, SpO2 91% on room air
Troponin I 4.8 ng/mL (markedly elevated)
Creatinine 1.4 mg/dL

case_journey.event: ST elevation in leads II, III, aVF — inferior wall
case_journey.label: ST elevation in leads II, III, aVF — inferior wall

_provenance.source_text: 12-lead ECG shows ST elevation in leads II, III, aVF

case_journey.event: EF 30% — severely reduced, inferior wall hypokinesis
case_journey.label: EF 30% — severely reduced, inferior wall hypokinesis

_provenance.source_text: Bedside echo: EF 30%, inferior wall hypokinesis

case_journey.event: Acute inferior STEMI — likely RCA occlusion
case_journey.label: Acute inferior STEMI — likely RCA occlusion

_provenance.source_text: Acute inferior STEMI, likely RCA occlusion
complicated by cardiogenic shock (Killip class III)
Aspirin 325 mg chewed, ticagrelor 180 mg loading dose
ticagrelor 180 mg loading dose
heparin bolus 60 U/kg
IV normal saline 500 mL bolus
Patient denies any history of contrast allergy

case_journey.event: PCI to RCA — drug-eluting stent, door-to-balloon 68 min
case_journey.label: PCI to RCA — drug-eluting stent, door-to-balloon 68 min

_provenance.source_text: PCI to RCA with drug-eluting stent placement. Door-to-balloon time 68 minutes. TIMI 3 flow restored.
Moderate mitral regurgitation noted (new)
Atorvastatin 80 mg started

case_journey.event: Metoprolol 12.5 mg — low dose, BP tolerated
case_journey.label: Metoprolol 12.5 mg — low dose, BP tolerated

_provenance.source_text: Metoprolol 12.5 mg initiated once BP tolerated
Ramipril 2.5 mg started on day 2 with stable creatinine
Repeat echo on day 3 showed EF 35% (improving)

case_journey.event: Patient ambulated 50m with assistance — with assistance
case_journey.label: Patient ambulated 50m with assistance — with assistance

_provenance.source_text: Patient ambulated 50m with assistance on day 3
Discharged home on day 5 in stable condition
Cardiac rehab referral placed
Follow-up echo scheduled in 6 weeks
